title: Board
turnOffContent: Agents will stop using this board. Cards and history are kept, and you can still read and edit them.

states.errorDescription: Check that AionUi is running, then try again.
states.offline: You're offline. Changes can't be saved until the connection is back.
states.notFoundDescription: This project doesn't exist any more, or it has no board.
states.emptyBoard: No cards yet. Add the first one to get started.
states.readOnlyDescription: This project is archived, so its board can't be changed.
states.disabledDescription: Keep this project's ideas, bugs and fixes in one task list shared by every conversation in the project.
states.templateSimpleDescription: Four columns: Backlog, To do, In progress and Done.
states.disabledBanner: The board is off. Agents can't use it, but you can still read and edit cards.

quickAdd.label: Add a card to {{column}}
quickAdd.titleTooLong: Titles can be at most {{max}} characters.

dnd.instructions: To pick up a card, press Space or Enter. Use the arrow keys to move it within a column or to another column. Press Space or Enter again to drop it, or Escape to cancel.

errors.wipLimit: {{column}} is full. Finish or move a card out first.
errors.wipLimitGeneric: That column is full. Finish or move a card out first.
errors.versionConflict: This card was changed somewhere else. The latest version is shown now.
errors.archived: This board is read-only because the project is archived.
errors.notFound: That card or board no longer exists.
errors.invalid: Some values are invalid or too long.
errors.dependencyCycle: That dependency would create a loop.
errors.exitRule: This card can't leave its column yet: required reviews or answers are missing.
errors.gateUseDecision: This card needs your decision before it can move.
errors.rateLimited: Too many changes in a short time. Try again in a minute.
errors.noProject: This conversation has no project board.
errors.wrongProject: That card belongs to another project.
errors.busy: Another change to this card is still running. Try again shortly.
errors.network: Can't reach AionUi. Check your connection and try again.
